concerns.text: SC-003 requires measuring whether 100 realizations per W achieve ≥80% power to detect slope deviation from -2 at α=0.05. No task performs this power analysis: T005 covers regression/Bonferroni (SC-001/SC-005), and T010 only reports 'power/representativeness limitations' as narrative. The tasks' own coverage map lists SC-001/SC-003/SC-005 under T005, but T005's body contains no power computation. Add a power-analysis step (e.g., in stats.py, output to data/processed/) so SC-003 is actually measured.

Principle VI requires ill-conditioned eigenproblem instances to 'trigger a warning AND be excluded from final scaling analyses.' T004 logs failed fits to warnings.json/skipped_realizations.json but no task implements exclusion of high-residual (ill-conditioned) instances from the regression inputs consumed by T005. Add an explicit filtering step between T004 and T005.

FR-008 and the spec's large-L edge case require handling L=1600. T002 implements the sparse fallback for L=1600, but no task ever runs L=1600 (T004 loops over L_LIST, which per plan is {100,200,400,800}). The spec's large-L case is implemented but never exercised; add L=1600 to the study domain or a dedicated verification run.
